doc: docs/06 §4: a llama-server dose is a launch flag, so the prototype binds it by relaunching the server at a stage change (`LLM.apply_stage_steering`, `StageSteering.gd`). This file maps a `TurnRequest.dose` key (docs/06 §3, `Steering.dose_for`) to the shipped control-vector file and records the provenance of each vector. Adding a path vector (P3.04: possessive/unstable/contempt/hollow/aware/lucid, docs/06 §2) is a row here plus the .gguf — no code change. A key listed under `unbound` is scheduled on the request but binds no file yet, so the restart leaves it out instead of inventing a scale.

malice.neurons: L14 N8949 +1, L13 N7956 -1 (unit ffn_down columns)
malice.doc: docs/06 §1/§2 malice axis (the tweet vector): the scale is the `malice` column of docs/06 §3, i.e. docs/02 §9's 'steering dose (base)'. Renamed from the experiment's placeholder so no brand name ships. Rebuild it with steer_build.py if the shipped GGUF changes (docs/06 §5).

possessive.neurons: 200 devoted ↔ possessive contrastive pairs, mean residual diff at layers 10–20, unit L2 per layer
possessive.doc: docs/06 §2 YANDERE path vector. P3.03 blind read: keep (7/10 at scale 0.5 — paths.json decision); the P3.04 weight curve in dose.json rides the ≤0.5 coherent band.

aware.neurons: 200 in-character ↔ model-awareness contrastive pairs, mean residual diff at layers 10–20, unit L2 per layer
aware.doc: docs/06 §2 AWAKE path vector. P3.03 blind read: keep (8/10 at 0.5); the P3.03 probe found 0 retention/logging claims. The other four P3.03 vectors (unstable, contempt, hollow, lucid) scored fallback — prompt-only (D21), files still ship on disk but no dose key maps to them, so an unexpected key fails control_vector_unmapped instead of binding one.

unbound.path_mix: docs/06 §3 interim path weight, scheduled only while the narrative path is unassigned (before GameState.path is set): nothing is bound because the path — and therefore the vector — does not exist yet. Once ctx.path carries an id the slot is the keep vector's name (possessive/aware) per dose.json `path_vectors`; the four fallback paths schedule no path weight (prompt-only, D21).
